landing.heroBadge: Higher Technological Institute • CS Class of 2026
landing.heroTitle: Your Entire Academic Semester in One Calm, Focused Space.
landing.heroSubtitle: UniStream22 organizes departmental announcements, personalized weekly lecture schedules, lab groups, and study notes for 4th-year computer science students — fast, clean, and distraction-free.
landing.previewAnnounceTitle: Digital Image Processing — Lab Assignment #3 Guidelines
landing.previewAnnounceContent: Please submit your Spatial Filtering code on the institute portal before next Thursday at 11:59 PM.
landing.previewNoteContent: Finalize dataset preprocessing for Data Mining project with team before Sunday.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Every tool is intentionally crafted to save you time and remove distractions throughout your final academic year.
landing.feat1Desc: All lecture slides, assignment deadlines, and department alerts published directly by faculty, sorted by week and priority.
landing.feat2Desc: A weekly class schedule built automatically from your assigned lab and lecture groups, highlighting today's upcoming sessions.
landing.feat3Desc: Never miss an announcement meant for your section. Filter feeds and classes by Group 1 through 6 or global announcements.
landing.feat4Desc: Create study notes, checklist items, and exam reminders on a clean personal board with color tags and instant cloud sync.
landing.feat5Desc: Install UniStream22 directly onto your phone or laptop. Fast loading and reliable offline access even in poor campus connectivity.
landing.feat6Desc: Verified student accounts tied to your HTI Academic ID. Clean, calm academic interface with zero ads and zero visual clutter.
landing.curriculumSubtitle: Full integration for all Semester 2 lecture schedules, lab sections, and assignments.
landing.course1Desc: Image enhancement, spatial filtering, frequency domain, and edge detection.
landing.course2Desc: Cloud architectures, virtualization, serverless models, and distributed systems.
landing.course3Desc: Pattern evaluation, classification algorithms, clustering, and association rules.
landing.course4Desc: Network protocols, OSI reference model, transmission media, and routing logic.
landing.course5Desc: Problem formulation, literature review, systems architecture, and milestones.
landing.groupsCardDesc: Custom group allocation for Groups 1 to 6. Switch your section anytime to update your schedule instantly.
landing.workflowSubtitle: No complex verification or complicated setup. Designed specifically for HTI CS students.
landing.step1Desc: Register with your 8-digit HTI academic ID (4202xxxx) and set up your secure password.
landing.step2Desc: Choose your assigned section and lab group for each of the 5 Fourth-Year CS courses.
landing.step3Desc: View your personalized timetable, read course updates, and manage your study notes.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join your fellow HTI Fourth-Year CS colleagues and stay on top of all your lectures and notices.
